takeaways: None of this UTB material is on the site; the anchor for a new UTB case study is March 2024 cell 10 (looking up the rotunda to the stained-glass dome, 5), which should be the cover, paired with July 2024 cell 25 (looking down the rotunda, 4) and the November 2024 roof sunset gable (cell 1, 4; has lens flare). The case-study story is tenant engagement, and it can be told with the Taste of UTB mezzanine overhead (70), the packed Make-A-Wish lobby (12), the Millie's ice-cream van shot (July 24, 46) and the National Cocktail Day carousel (2024 cell 4) as proof of tenant-restaurant cross-promotion for service:organic-social. Food and cocktail stills (Feb 2024 pancakes 84, 2025 orchid cocktail 24, Speckled Egg sandwich 60) are good content-development gallery fill. Hero-loop options are thin (only the 14s dome clip, March 2024 cell 82, is worth checking), because the Q Theatre folder shows only the set being built, the drone folder has no usable aerials, and the finished reels here are static staff spotlights (3).
